selection_policy: Overview Section 18.2 / Section 24.2 - Explicit promotion based on validation macro-F1, tie-break hierarchy, and run-once final test evaluation

lettuce.rationale: Validation Macro-F1 tied at 0.7461 with Random Forest. Decision Tree chosen per tie-break hierarchy step 4 (parsimony and full interpretable white-box logic). Passed run-once held-out test evaluation with 0.7613 Macro-F1 and 0.9877 Accuracy.

spinach.rationale: Validation Macro-F1 reached 1.0000 with clean, non-overfitting boundary separation. Verified on 280 held-out test split samples with 1.0000 Macro-F1.

tomato.rationale: Highest validation Macro-F1 (0.9689) across all 5 candidate families on 10-class nutrient stress problem. Evaluated on 8,830 held-out test samples yielding 0.9685 Macro-F1. Per Canonical Overview Section 15 and ADR 0005, tomato sensor model strictly maintains 'experimental=true' due to rule-synthesized label boundaries.
